summary: Phase 4 consent/grant integration verified against all six acceptance criteria. Bridge client, session-bound consent UI, idempotent non-broadening grant upsert, ownership-checked management routes, and per-call revocation all implemented and covered by passing tests.
follow_up: Deployed browser OAuth acceptance and public-ingress proof remain in Phases 6-7 per the plan; this verification is local component proof only.
important_context: Consent routes mount only when both AUTH_BRIDGE_URL and AUTH_BRIDGE_SECRET are set (config.auth_bridge_enabled); grant-management API remains the authoritative surface when the bridge is disabled.
Grant upsert intersects requested calendars/scopes with live unarchived membership and can only narrow an existing active grant; broadening requires revoke + re-authorize.
mcp_consent_receipt stores a SHA-256 digest of the handoff token (not the token) to make retries idempotent and block cross-user/decision mismatch and revoked-grant recreation.
